t: 葡萄牙海军在印度迪乌战役中击败了奥斯曼帝国的一支联合舰队威尼斯共和国,古吉拉特苏丹,埃及的马姆…
te: The Portuguese navy defeats a joint fleet of the Ottoman Empire, the Republic of Venice, the Sultan of Gujarat, the Mam…
dz: 葡萄牙海军在印度迪乌战役中击败了奥斯曼帝国的一支联合舰队威尼斯共和国,古吉拉特苏丹,埃及的马姆列克·布尔吉苏丹国,卡利克的扎莫林和拉古萨共和国.
de: The Portuguese navy defeats a joint fleet of the Ottoman Empire, the Republic of Venice, the Sultan of Gujarat, the Mamlûk Burji Sultanate of Egypt, the Zamorin of Calicut, and the Republic of Ragusa at the Battle of Diu in Diu, India.

t: 亨利八世在其父亲亨利七世去世后登上英国王位。
te: Henry VIII ascends the throne of England on the death of his father, Henry VII.
dz: 亨利八世在其父亲亨利七世去世后登上英国王位。
de: Henry VIII ascends the throne of England on the death of his father, Henry VII.

t: 教皇朱利叶斯二世将意大利威尼斯州置于禁令之下。
te: Pope Julius II places the Italian state of Venice under interdict.
dz: 教皇朱利叶斯二世将意大利威尼斯州置于禁令之下。
de: Pope Julius II places the Italian state of Venice under interdict.

t: 在意大利北部,法军击败了威尼斯共和国.
te: In northern Italy, French forces defeat the Republic of Venice.
dz: 阿格纳德洛战役: 在意大利北部,法军击败了威尼斯共和国.
de: Battle of Agnadello: In northern Italy, French forces defeat the Republic of Venice.

t: 英国亨利八世与阿拉贡的凯瑟琳结婚。
te: Henry VIII of England marries Catherine of Aragon.
dz: 英国亨利八世与阿拉贡的凯瑟琳结婚。
de: Henry VIII of England marries Catherine of Aragon.

t: 阿拉贡的亨利八世和凯瑟琳被加冕为英格兰国王和女王.
te: Henry VIII and Catherine of Aragon are crowned King and Queen of England.
dz: 阿拉贡的亨利八世和凯瑟琳被加冕为英格兰国王和女王.
de: Henry VIII and Catherine of Aragon are crowned King and Queen of England.

t: 克里希纳德瓦拉亚作为维贾亚纳加拉皇帝登上王位,标志着维贾亚纳加拉帝国的再生.
te: Krishnadevaraya ascends to the throne as Emperor of Vijayanagara, marking the beginning of the regeneration of the Vija…
dz: 克里希纳德瓦拉亚作为维贾亚纳加拉皇帝登上王位,标志着维贾亚纳加拉帝国的再生.
de: Krishnadevaraya ascends to the throne as Emperor of Vijayanagara, marking the beginning of the regeneration of the Vijayanagara Empire.

t: 克里希纳德瓦·拉亚被加冕为奇特多尔的维贾亚纳加拉皇帝.
te: Krishnadeva Raya is crowned Emperor of Vijayanagara at Chittoor.
dz: 克里希纳德瓦·拉亚被加冕为奇特多尔的维贾亚纳加拉皇帝.
de: Krishnadeva Raya is crowned Emperor of Vijayanagara at Chittoor.

t: 一场被称作"较小的审判日"的地震袭击了君士坦丁堡.
te: An earthquake known as "The Lesser Judgment Day" hits Constantinople.
dz: 一场被称作"较小的审判日"的地震袭击了君士坦丁堡.
de: An earthquake known as "The Lesser Judgment Day" hits Constantinople.
